hooks.command: case "$PWD" in */.claude/worktrees/*) exit 0;; esac; count=$(ps -eo command 2>/dev/null | grep -c "^claude"); if [ "$count" -gt 1 ]; then printf "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"UserPromptSubmit\",\"additionalContext\":\"PARALLEL SESSIONS DETECTED (%s CLI sessions active): You MUST call EnterWorktree before editing any files if you have not already. See CLAUDE.md ALWAYS Use Worktrees section.\"}}\n" "$count"; fi

case "$PWD" in */.claude/worktrees/*) exit 0;; esac; count=$(ps -eo command 2>/dev/null | grep -c "^claude"); if [ "$count" -gt 1 ]; then printf "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"BLOCKED: %s parallel claude sessions detected and you are NOT in a worktree. Call EnterWorktree before editing files. See CLAUDE.md.\"}}\n" "$count"; fi

if [ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && [ -f "$HOME/.secrets" ]; then source "$HOME/.secrets" 2>/dev/null && env | grep -vE "^(_|SHELL|HOME|USER|LOGNAME|PATH|TERM|PWD|OLDPWD|SHLVL|CLAUDE_)" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; fi

FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "$FILE" in *.py) ruff format --quiet "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || .venv/bin/ruff format --quiet "$FILE" 2>/dev/null;; *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.json|*.css|*.svelte) npx prettier --write --log-level silent "$FILE" 2>/dev/null;; esac; exit 0
